title: Woodcasting Versus Thermoplast Splint in CMC Arthroplasty
official: Patient Satisfaction for Post-Operative Carpometacarpal Arthroplasty: Wood Casting Versus Thermoplastic Splint
summary: This study is a prospective, randomized, nonblinded trial to evaluate patient preference in splints after having a carpometacarpal arthroplasty.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients over the age of 18 years old.
* Intact Medical Decision Making
* Eligible for Surgical Intervention
* Willing to comply with all aspects of the treatment and evaluation schedule over 6 weeks

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant Women
* Deemed Unsuitable by Principal Investigator
sponsor: Foundation for Orthopaedic Research and Education
